mapper.select: SELECT d.email AS email, u.nickname AS nickname, u.image_url AS image_url, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM music_discovery d JOIN "user" u ON u.email = d.email WHERE d.discovered_at >= #{start} AND d.discovered_at < #{end} GROUP BY d.email, u.nickname, u.image_url ORDER BY cnt DESC, d.email LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.email AS email, u.nickname AS nickname, u.image_url AS image_url, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM play_history p JOIN "user" u ON u.email = p.email WHERE p.played_at >= #{start} AND p.played_at < #{end} AND p.email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.email, u.nickname, u.image_url ORDER BY cnt DESC, p.email LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.user_email AS email, u.nickname AS nickname, u.image_url AS image_url, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM music_report r JOIN "user" u ON u.email = r.user_email WHERE r.created_at >= #{start} AND r.created_at < #{end} AND r.user_email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.user_email, u.nickname, u.image_url ORDER BY cnt DESC, r.user_email LIMIT #{limit}
